changelog: v3.8.1.0: The intro played again on every episode after a server restart. The once-per-series rule read LastPlayedDate on the Series item, which Jellyfin never writes, so only an in-memory cache held the intro back and every restart cleared it. The check now asks the library for a played or resumable episode under the series, which holds across seasons and restarts. v3.8.0.0: A request made with a Jellyfin API key, or with no credentials, carries no user id, so it matched no policy and was served uncapped on every route. A new setting names the policy such requests are held to. Unset by default, so upgrading changes nothing.
description: Quality Gate lets Jellyfin administrators cap the resolution a user may be served. The cap is measured against the media's actual height, read from its video stream, so it holds whatever the file is called. Media above the cap is served as a capped transcode, or as a lower-resolution version of the same item where one exists, and requests for the original file are refused. Useful for bandwidth management and tiered access.
name: QualityGate
overview: Cap the resolution a user may be served, measured against the media's actual height.
